meta.title: DJI drone live streaming guides — DJI Live Bridge blog
meta.description: DJI Mini 5 Pro, Mini 4 Pro and DJI Fly live streaming guides: phone or computer setup, RTMP settings, and broadcasts to YouTube, Instagram and Facebook.

lead: Choose your drone or platform: Mini 5 Pro and Mini 4 Pro controller setups, phone and computer workflows, DJI Fly RTMP settings, and checks before your audience joins.

cta.p: DJI Live Bridge is free and open source, for macOS and Windows. FFmpeg is built in, so there is nothing else to install.

guides.sub: Step-by-step instructions for your drone, controller and platform.
